sources.market_model: Packaged digital services/Gigs, custom offers, inbound buyer discovery and order-based delivery
sources.auth_mode: Operator-owned Fiverr account; platform-native authorized features only
sources.escrow_model: Buyer pays Fiverr in advance for orders; Fiverr releases seller earnings under platform payment terms
sources.fee_model: Freelancers currently receive 80% of completed order value; buyer-side service fees apply separately
sources.reputation_model: Seller levels, Success Score, ratings, response and order-performance metrics
sources.dispute_model: Fiverr Resolution Center and platform order/dispute processes
sources.task_state_model: Gig/custom offer -> order -> delivery/revision -> completion -> clearing -> withdrawal
sources.rate_limits: No autonomous website scraping/crawling; use permitted operator/platform-native surfaces
platform_constraints: Current Terms prohibit unauthorized bots, automation software, crawlers, scraping and systematic extraction
Do not build an autonomous Fiverr browser scraper
Seller economics must absorb the current 20% platform share
Reputation/levels materially affect discovery and conversion
Inbound package positioning is more important than proposal automation
sources.observability: Large visible AI Agents/automation service category; platform-native seller tooling and AI Personal Assistant available to eligible users
sources.source_contract_version: Terms last updated January 2026; current help pages verified 2026-09-12
reentry_conditions: Re-evaluate automation boundary if Fiverr publishes an official machine interface for seller/job workflows
Re-evaluate execution allocation after actual Gig impressions/inquiries/orders are measured
Re-evaluate package scope after OCE capability cost curve changes
notes: Fiverr remains strategically included even without autonomous website access
Initial path is package/pricing intelligence plus operator-owned service publication
